messages:
maya: saw a second wave of cross-region retries and TLS handshakes this morning, starting ~06:12 UTC. spikes in 5xx and client retries. filing here for postmortem follow-ups and owners.
ben: saw the same in dashboards. errors correlate with egress to eu-west from us-east 1 via the primary translation path.
sophie: alerted oncall at 06:18. stacktrace points to handshake failures on the edge LB side (SNI mismatch-ish). logs: `tls: server hello mismatch` repeated.
eric: capturing a quick tcpdump from a failed session:
```
# tcpdump -i eth0 host 3.5.7.9 and port 443
06:13:22.123456 IP us-east-proxy > eu-lb: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240
06:13:22.124002 IP eu-lb > us-east-proxy: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0
```
ashley: stack traces + LB routing table snapshot attached to thread (see runbook link). pattern looks like intermittent route to an out-of-date pool that serves an old cert.
maya: root-cause hypothesis: routing flap caused a subset of requests to hit legacy LB instances with old certs -> TLS handshake drop -> clients retry -> downstream spikes. also noticed higher-backoff loops in our SDKs causing extra retries.
ben: immediate mitigations we applied at 06:30 UTC: drained legacy pool, force-reload certs on edge, and added a short routing hold to prevent BGP churn during the rollout. metrics recovered ~06:42.
sophie: action items from triage meeting (owner / ETA):
  1) ben -> confirm permanent route cleanup and remove legacy pool references (ETA 2026-03-30)
  2) eric -> update LB cert rotation verification in deploy pipeline with post-deploy sanity checks (ETA 2026-03-28)
  3) ashley -> add an instrumentation counter to track SNI mismatch TLS errors and alert threshold (ETA 2026-03-25)
  4) maya -> runbook update with explicit rollback and drain steps for cross-region rollouts (ETA 2026-03-26)
  5) sophie -> schedule follow-up postmortem and recurring 2-week check for similar retry patterns (ETA 2026-04-06)
ops-bot: created ticket RH-3819 (www.internal/rh/3819) and assigned to ben, eric, ashley, maya.
ben: plan for RH-3819: break into smaller PRs: route cleanup, e2e cert test, pipeline gate. I'll link PRs once started.
maya: additional notes on long-term mitigations:
  - add active e2e TLS probes between regions that validate SNI/cert chain and surface early warnings
  - implement a short lived client-side backoff jitter to avoid retry storm during partial routing failures
  - instrument route-change events tied to canary deploys for automatic rollback when TLS metrics degrade
sophie: let's add a post-deploy smoke check in Dedicated and Private flows too. cross-region tests often miss those.
eric: quick config snippet for the smoke test (will PR):
```
curl -k -s -D - https://edge.example.com/health -H 'Host: api.redwood.example' | grep -i "Server:" || exit 1
```
ashley: I'm scheduling a 30m sync Friday 13:00 UTC to go over runbook diffs and ticket splits. invite will go out.
ben: noted. I'll aim to finish route cleanup by Monday and open the cert-test PR tonight.
maya: owners — please drop quick status updates in this thread as you make progress. prefix with "RH-3819" so ops-bot picks it up.
sophie: re: recurring pattern: ops has seen 3x similar cross-region retry spikes in the last 6 months. we should track recurrence in the postmortem and add to monthly reliability review.
ben: adding a telemetry spike alert for retry rate > 2% for > 5m across cross-region routes. will PR alert logic.
maya: thanks all. leaving follow-ups assigned. we'll close RH-3819 when PRs merged, instrumentation alerts in place, and runbook updated.
deploy-bot: deploy started for cert-rotation-refresh at 06:28 UTC (staged). no deploy-related errors in pipeline logs.
ops-bot: RH-3819 status=open; next_check=2026-03-25T12:00:00Z.
